data.text:
Moteen Ahmad Bikka vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 
January, 2024 
Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh
Bench: Saumitra Dayal Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:6862-Db
Court No. - 39
Case :- Writ - C No. - 44714 of 2023
Petitioner :- Moteen Ahmad Bikka
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rizwan Ahmad(Qureshi),Zulfikar Ali 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1.  Petitioner seeks a license to run a meat shop and poultry farm. Under the existing laws, he has submitted his application for issuance of that license, through online mode. That license is to be granted under the Food Safety Act by the Prescribed Authority/respondent no. 2. The application itself has remained pending since 13.11.2023 for reason of pendency of no objection certificate to be issued by the Superintendent of Police. 
Moteen Ahmad Bikka vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86163708/
1 2. Since sufficient time has passed, the petitioner has approached the Court for direction upon the respondent no. 3/Superintendent of Police, Azamgarh to issue such no objection certificate, at the earliest. 
3. Learned Standing Counsel has objected to the prayer made on the strength of written instructions received by him. Copy of the same has produced in Court. It has been marked as 'X' and retained on record. The written instructions contained the response of Police Station Deogaon, District Azamgarh. The two paragraph objection raised by the police authority reads as below :
"I. ?? ???? ?? ?????? ??? ?????? ???? ?? ?? ?????? ????? ????? ???? ?????? ????? ????
?????? ??????-????? ? ?????-????? ???????, ????? ???-06 ????-??????? ???????,
????-?????? ?????? ????? ??????? ??? ???? ?? ????? ?? ???????? ???? ????? ???? ??
?????? ??? ??? ?????? ???????? ?? ??? ??, ????? ?????? ??? ?????? ???? ?? ?? ?????
??????? ??????? ???? ?? ????? ???? ????? ??? ?????? ????? ?????? ??? ?????? ???? ????
?? ?? ???? ?????? ??? ?????? ??????? ???? ?? ????? ??, ????? ?????? ???????? ??? ????
??? ??????? ?? ????? ?? ??????? ???? ???? ?? ????? ???????? ??, ????? ???? ??????
????? ?? ???? ?? ????? ?? ???????? ???????? ???? ???? ??? ???
II. ?? ??????? ?? ??? ?????? ???????? ?? ???????? ??, ?????? ?????? ???? ?? ?? ??????
????? ?? ???? ?? ????? ?? ???? ?????? ???????? ?? ??? ???? ??? ??????? ?? ????? ?
??????? ??????? ?? ???????? ?? ????? ??? ?????? ????? ?? ???? ?? ????? ?? ????????
???? ???? ???? ?? ???????? ???? ?? ??? ???"
4. Prima facie, we find the objection to be wholly misconceived. It is wholly opaque and unreasoned. 
The objection contains an inference without consideration of any fact or occurrence. It does not even state that there does not exist any other meat shop in the area. It being a matter of dietary habits,
the fact that different communities may be living together in an area may never be relevant or sufficient to object to issuance of a license to sell food product or food items. 
5. Since no objection certificate is required to be issued by the Superintendent of Police, we dispose of the writ petition with the direction, the respondent no. 2 shall act mindful of the observations made above and issue appropriate no objection certificate to the petitioner, within a period of fifteen days from today, as also sensitise the field officers to remain mindful of the consideration to be offered by them while dealing with such applications, in future. 
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 SA (Manjive Shukla, J.) (S.D. Singh, J.)
